GLS.feature.stream.title: Stream Client
GLS.feature.stream.hint: A dedicated login for OBS or browser capture: hides Foundry's UI, frames the canvas camera, and shows chat and presentation overlays. A control panel drives the live shot.
User id of the dedicated stream client. The Director UI provides a user picker.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.settings.autoStartStre: Stream user ids that should enter stream mode automatically without prompting.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.settings.trustedDirect: User ids allowed to operate stream controls in addition to GMs.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.settings.uiRules.name: Stream UI Rules
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.settings.uiRules.hint: Allow/block rules for detected floating UI and expert CSS selectors.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.keybindings.emergencyR: Temporarily restore or hide Foundry UI while stream mode remains active.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.startPrompt.title: Start Stream Mode?
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.startPrompt.body: This user is configured as the stream client. Start stream mode for this session?
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.startPrompt.alwaysHint: Always enter stream mode on this user at startup. A Stream Director can revoke this later.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.notifications.notDirec: You are not allowed to operate stream controls.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.menu.controlRoom.name: Stream Control Room
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.menu.controlRoom.label: Open Control Room
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.menu.controlRoom.hint: Start and stop the stream, frame the camera, and set the chat, dialog and UI rules for the capture client.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.notifications.readOnly: Your changes cannot be saved: this world does not allow a non-GM director to send them. Ask a GM to make the change, or to run the stream themselves.
Your changes cannot be saved while no GM is connected: a director's edits are applied by a GM's client. This panel starts saving again as soon as one signs in.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.settings.chatFilter.hi: Which content types reach the stream chat overlay, set separately for players and the GM.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.menu.chatFilter.name: Stream Chat Filter
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.menu.chatFilter.label: Open Chat Filter
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.menu.chatFilter.hint: Choose exactly what the stream overlay shows — checks, damage, spells, plain rolls, typed chat, status changes — separately for what players post and what the GM posts.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.title: Stream Chat Filter
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.intro: Tick what the stream overlay may show. Each content type is switched separately for messages a player posted and messages the GM posted. Changes apply to the next card; cards already on screen stay until they expire.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.privacy: Whispers, GM blind rolls and other players’ private messages never reach the stream, whatever is ticked here.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.notApplicab: Does not apply to this column
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.presets.noC: Turn off in-character speech, emotes, thoughts and out-of-character chat for everyone. Rolls and statuses are untouched.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.presets.rol: Show checks, damage, spells, actions and dice rolls; hide typed chat, status cards and everything else.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.presets.def: Put every switch back to its default.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.group.check: Rolls against a DC or defence.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.group.actio: What a check leads to, and the cards for using an ability.
Rolls no system claimed as a check.
Lines a person typed into the chat box.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.group.statu: Conditions and effects arriving, changing or ending. Here the columns are whose creature it is: a player character, or one the GM runs (which also has to be visible on the scene).
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.group.other: Only used where chat cards are cloned as-is (worlds other than PF2e and Daggerheart, or Roll Cards switched off).
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.skill.h: Athletics, Stealth, Recall Knowledge and every other skill.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.percept: Seek, Sense Motive and other Perception rolls.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.initiat: Initiative rolls when an encounter starts.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.flat.hi: Concealment, persistent damage recovery, stupefied and other flat checks.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.counter: Dispel Magic and other counteract attempts.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.check.h: Any PF2e check of no more specific kind.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.duality: A player's Hope and Fear dice: trait rolls, attacks and spellcasting.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.reactio: Duality dice rolled as a reaction, which give no Hope and no Fear.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.adversa: The GM's d20 for an adversary's attack. Adversary reactions are whispered to the GM and never shown.
Damage rolls, merged under the attack or spell that caused them when that card is shown.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.spell.h: The card a spell posts when it is cast.
Cards for using an action or feat with no roll of its own.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.feature: A domain card, ancestry, community or other feature posted from a sheet, with its cost.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.roll.hi: /r 2d6+3, macro rolls, and any roll that is not a check or damage.
Something said as a character, and the GM's Narrator lines.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.emote.h: Posted with /emote, or in Roleplay Chat's Do mode.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.thought: Roleplay Chat's Think mode. A thought is shown to the whole table.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.ooc.hin: Table talk, and anything typed with no character speaking. Off by default: the table's, not the broadcast's.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.conditi: Frightened, prone, dying, persistent damage and the rest of the printed list.
Spell effects, stances and feat effects. There are a great many of these.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.row.other.h: Item cards, system summaries and messages from other modules.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.detailsHint: What a shown roll card may say. A GM roll never shows a DC of its own or a player name, so those have no GM switch.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.detail.degr: Critical success, success, failure or critical failure. In Daggerheart, success or failure and an adversary's hit or miss; With Hope, With Fear and Critical always show.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.detail.dc.h: The DC a player rolled against.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.detail.targ: Who the roll was against. A name players cannot see is hidden either way.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.detail.play: The name of the person who rolled, under the character.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.chatFilter.nonPf2e: Roll card details (degree, DC, target, player name) apply to PF2e and Daggerheart roll cards only. In this world chat cards are cloned as-is.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.actions.startHint: Ask the stream login to enter stream mode.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.actions.stopHint: Take the stream login out of stream mode.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.actions.uiHint: Show or hide Foundry's own UI on the stream for a moment, while stream mode stays on.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.actions.reframeHi: Frame the current camera target again. Falls back to the scene when the mode has no target.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.camera.heading: Camera
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.camera.panSpeedHi: How fast the camera crosses the map, in grid squares per second. Very short and very long moves are held to a comfortable length. Applies to every mode.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.camera.includeTar: When the framed token is targeting others, widen the shot to keep them in view too.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.spotlight.heading: Spotlight
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.spotlight.unused: used when In combat is Spotlight
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.spotlight.zoomHin: The exact canvas zoom at the active token. It ignores fit or fill and the min and max zoom.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.spotlight.travelH: When the spotlight moves somewhere off the middle of the screen, the camera zooms out by up to this much, crosses, and zooms back in. 1 turns it off.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.spotlight.players: Only spotlight player-owned tokens. Other turns frame the visible combatants.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.spotlight.hint: Spotlight follows whoever's turn it is, in combat only, at the zoom above. It widens down to Min zoom to hold that token's targets when Keep targets in frame is on. Short moves pan; longer ones zoom out, cross and zoom back in.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.tracking.heading: Tracked tokens
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.chat.heading: Chat overlay
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.chat.filterHint: Choose, per content type, what players' and the GM's messages put on the stream.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.chat.cardScaleHin: How big roll cards are drawn, on top of the scale that matches the stream's width to the 1920px design frame.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.dialog.heading: Presentations
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.dialog.hint: Dialogs, images and journals shown to the players appear in the middle of the stream. 0 keeps them up until the stream login clicks outside them.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.ui.heading: Foundry UI on the stream
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.ui.layerHint: The z-index an allowed element gets in stream mode. Leave it blank to keep its own stacking.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.ui.empty: No floating UI has been seen on the stream login yet.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.ui.hint: Floating windows other modules open on the stream login show up here as they appear. The overlay itself, chat and presentations, sits at layer 100000.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.access.noLogin: Pick one on the Access tab
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.access.autoStartO: This login enters stream mode by itself when it signs in.
This login asks before entering stream mode.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.access.directorsH: Players who may drive the stream from this room. GMs always can. Their edits are saved by a connected GM's client.
GLUNIVERSE_STREAM.room.access.adminOnly: Only a GM can choose the stream login or appoint directors.
